svg.title: Center Cluster ESP32-P4 Wiring Diagram
svg.desc: Wiring diagram of the center cluster J8 40-pin GPIO connector, left and right cluster boards, CAN transceiver, buck power converter, three rotary encoders, a push button, the onboard touch/audio I2C bus, and the headlight-sense input. Wires are colored by signal type; text always renders above wires.
svg.text: Pin order is schematic (grouped by device), not physical header order -- see PINOUT.md for the real 2x20 layout. Labels/numbers/wiring match firmware.
CANH / CANL to CAN Bus (Link G4X ECU, 1 Mbit/s, 120 ohm term.)
VIN / GND from Vehicle 12V harness (switched / IGN)
Note: physical connector pinout unverified on this rev (see CONNECTOR_BOM_AND_HARNESS.md)
Note: physical connector pinout unverified on this rev (see CONNECTOR_BOM_AND_HARNESS.md)
Switch-to-GND when headlights on. Do NOT feed +12V to this pin.
Wiring per PINOUT.md / WIRING.md / Kconfig.projbuild (matches firmware). Harness CSV/HTML use different J8 pin numbers for the same GPIOs -- flagged as stale, not used here.
